name.zh: CTExcel 英国（中国电信欧洲）

tagline.en: China Telecom Europe's UK MVNO on EE — China–UK shared data from £9.9, free SIM
tagline.zh: 中国电信欧洲英国虚商（EE网络）：中英共享流量9.9镑起，可免费领卡

description.en: CTExcel UK is China Telecom (Europe)'s personal mobile brand (since 2012), an MVNO on EE — independent of CMLink (China Mobile system). Official prices (2026-09): UK 3GB £4.90; China–UK shared 22GB £9.9 / 50GB £11.9 / 120GB £14.9 / 300GB £19.9; Unlimited tier £29.9 (£23.9 promo). Free SIM via freecard campaign; ordering a bundle at card claim waives the £1 pre-load. Auto-cancel after 90 days of non-use.
description.zh: CTExcel UK 是中国电信（欧洲）旗下个人移动品牌（2012 年上线），走 EE 网络的虚商——与中国移动系的 CMLink 相互独立。官方价（2026-09）：英国 3GB 4.90 镑；中英共享 22GB 9.9 / 50GB 11.9 / 120GB 14.9 / 300GB 19.9 镑；无限量档 29.9 镑（促销 23.9）。freecard 活动免费领卡、领卡同时订购套餐免 1 镑预充。90 天无使用自动销号。

details.en:
CTE UK is the China Telecom counterpart to CMLink's China Mobile lineage: an EE MVNO aimed at UK–China users. Official plan list (2026-09): UK-only 3GB/30d £4.90; China–UK shared bundles 22GB £9.9, 50GB £11.9, 120GB £14.9, 300GB £19.9 (300GB tier adds 20GB EU); Unlimited £29.9 (£23.9 promo) with 300GB China + 30GB UK/EU. £11.9+ tiers include 200 UK minutes to 15 international destinations incl. China. One-card-two-numbers, eSIM available (re-opened; physical→eSIM conversion costs £3 per community reports), port-in supported.

Acquisition cost is lower than CMLink's: the freecard campaign gives the SIM free, and ordering a bundle at claim time waives the £1 pre-load. Community sources report no real-name KYC needed (unofficial). Keep-alive: auto-cancellation after 90 days without usage — bundles renew per 30 days.

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): landing IP similar to CMLink's; stability rated below CMLink; rumored future throttling unconfirmed. Verdict: cheaper and easier to open than CMLink, CMLink still stronger for long-term keep-alive.
details.zh:
CTE UK 与 CMLink 分属电信/移动两大系：同为 EE 虚商、面向中英人群。官方套餐表（2026-09）：英国本地 3GB/30天 4.90 镑；中英共享 22GB 9.9、50GB 11.9、120GB 14.9、300GB 19.9 镑（300GB 档另含 20GB 欧洲流量）；无限量 29.9 镑（促销 23.9，含 300GB 中国+30GB 英欧）。11.9 镑及以上含 200 分钟英国本地拨打含中国在内 15 个方向。支持一卡双号、eSIM（已重新开放，社区称实体转 eSIM 收 3 镑）、携号转网。

开卡成本低于 CMLink：freecard 活动免费领卡，领卡同时订购套餐再免 1 镑预充。社区口径无需实名（非官方）。保号：90 天无使用自动销号，套餐按 30 天滚动。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：落地 IP 与 CMLink 类似；稳定性评价不及 CMLink；「后续会限速」传闻未证实。结论：开卡比 CMLink 便宜省事，长期保号仍更推荐 CMLink。

bestFor.en: UK–China users wanting cheaper entry than CMLink with China–UK shared data.
bestFor.zh: 想要比CMLink更低开卡门槛、中英共享流量的用户。

country.zh: GB in UK (via EE); China-roaming landing unverified

note.en: China Telecom (Europe) MVNO on EE UK (confirmed by ISPreview hands-on). Community says the UK IP is clean; Reddit users pair it with a residential-IP VPN for China use, implying the stock exit is a standard EE mobile IP. No public IP-country test of China roaming found. CTE UK is the same CTExcel UK product family; IP behavior expected to match.
note.zh: 中国电信（欧洲）EE 网 MVNO（ISPreview 实测确认）。社区称英国 IP 纯净；Reddit 用户在中国使用时需另配住宅 VPN，暗示默认出口就是普通 EE 移动 IP。中国漫游落地国家未查到公开实测。 CTE UK 与 CTExcel UK 同属中国电信欧洲产品线，IP 行为预期一致。
